author: R3dninja34
quote: Ocarina of Time 3D was a great way to bring a classic into a new generation. Nintendo improved the graphics, textures and visuals while preserving the original art style, atmosphere and gameplay. It felt familiar, yet fresh. A perfect example of how to modernize a classic without losing what made it special.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D

author: R3dninja34
quote: Ocarina of Time (1998) is a timeless masterpiece. Its legacy speaks for itself. No amount of pointless 0/10 reviews can change that.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: R3dninja34
quote: Ocarina of Time shows how a remake should be done. Nintendo kept the original atmosphere, story and iconic locations intact without unnecessarily changing what made the game special. The creepy atmosphere and nostalgic feeling are still there. They improved the graphics and technology without destroying the original experience. That’s what fans want: a faithful remake that respects its roots instead of changing everything just to make it feel new. Sometimes you don’t need to reinvent a classic. You just need to understand why people loved it in the first place.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: R3dninja34
quote:
What increasingly bothers me about GTA 6 is Rockstar and Take-Two’s business practices.
First, there is the apparent favoritism towards Sony. It gives the impression that the PlayStation partnership matters more than the interests of the entire gaming community. A game of this scale should treat all players equally.Then there are the countless ways to squeeze even more money out of players: overpriced editions, content locked behind paywalls, and a business model that seems designed to satisfy investors rather than the **** physical disc situation is another major concern. Buying a physical copy should mean actually owning the game, being able to use it independently and resell it. If discs increasingly depend on downloads, online activation and restrictions, what’s even the point of buying a physical edition?Rockstar should never forget who made its success possible in the first place: the players. The hype surrounding GTA 6 is not a free pass to charge customers more while giving them less in return.A great game does not automatically mean a consumer-friendly business.
